decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established biodynamic range built on the firm's core in-house dairy know-how and close farmer relationships, so management can read its early results well and refine it, and it is a flagship of the firm's organic direction.

Mild sliced cheese draws directly on the firm's in-house cheesemaking expertise and existing retail channels, giving it high absorptive fit and low risk even though its market record is only one year old.

Sliced butter cheese is a close variant of the established cheese assortment, so the firm can interpret its performance and adjust the recipe or format with its own R&D rather than withdraw it after only one year on the market.
